purpose: Teach: 踏み出す/言い換える/照らす/仕え/出くわし/入り込む/病ん/すすん

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、進路の一歩を踏み出す時期だな
lines.en: Riku, you're at that point where you need to start thinking about your future.
lines.style: Casual, direct address. Light tease in the tone—sisterly, not cutting. Leans forward slightly. The kind of thing said while both are doing something else.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、専門用語を易しく言い換える能力あるな、桜
lines.en: You're surprisingly good at making complicated stuff sound simple, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine acknowledgment. Not overdone. Small smile underneath—he means it. Speaks like he's noticing something he hadn't quite said before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、懐中電灯で部屋を照らす遊びしてたな
lines.en: I saw you messing around with a flashlight in your room the other day.
lines.style: Dry, amused. Slight smirk in the voice. Not mocking—more like catching him in something harmless and ridiculous. Quick delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先輩に仕える後輩の鑑だな、桜
lines.en: You're like the textbook example of a good junior, honestly.
lines.style: Soft deflection masked as dry wit. He's fending off her sincerity with humor, but warmth leaks through. Slightly self-conscious laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、駅で先生に出くわして焦ってたな
lines.en: You panicked when you ran into your teacher at the station last week.
lines.style: Teasing edge. Remembering a specific moment with affection. Voice carries a smile—she's enjoying this, not hurting. Relaxed pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ゲームに入り込むと声かけられないな、桜
lines.en: When you're really into a game, you don't hear anything around you.
lines.style: Wry observation delivered with a half-laugh. Not accusing—noting a quirk he knows about himself. Matter-of-fact tone with warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、風邪で病んでた時心配したぞ
lines.en: I was worried about you when you had that cold.
lines.style: Quiet, direct. No performance. Just saying something true. Slight softness in the opening. Lets the sentence breathe at the end—vulnerability without flinching.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強がすすんでいるな、桜
lines.en: Your studying's actually going well, isn't it?
lines.style: Gentle observation. Not patronizing. Warm, almost relieved tone—he's noticing something he's been hoping for. Soft close on the question mark.
